answer_text:
Here is a comprehensive overview of **Mundra Port**:

---

### 🏗️ What is Mundra Port?

Mundra Port is the **largest commercial and container port in India**, located on the northern shores of the Gulf of Kutch near Mundra, Kutch district, **Gujarat**.

It is **India's first private port**, formerly operated by Mundra Port and Special Economic Zone Limited (MPSEZ) under the ownership of the **Adani Group**. It was later expanded to become **Adani Ports & SEZ Limited (APSEZ)**, managing several port projects.

---

### 📍 Location & Connectivity

The Mundra Port is located in the **Northern Gulf of Kutch**, en route major maritime routes and connected through **rail, road, air & pipelines**.

Mundra Port in Gujarat offers direct connectivity to major global markets including the **US East Coast, Europe, Middle East, and Africa**. It is linked to the national rail and highway networks, efficiently serving North and Northwest India's industrial and agricultural regions. Regular shipping routes connect Mundra to ports such as **Houston, Norfolk, Jebel Ali, and Port Tangier**.

---

### 📦 Cargo & Capacity

The port currently handles over **155 MT** of cargo — the highest in India — constituting nearly **11% of India's total annual maritime cargo**. The port also handles nearly **33% of India's container traffic**.

Mundra Port handles a variety of cargo ranging from **bulk cargo** like coal, grain, fertilizer, minerals, ores, steel, edible oils, chemicals, and petroleum products to **container cargo, automobiles, and crude oil**.

Mundra Port has a capacity to handle **338 MMT of cargo per annum** — the largest amongst all operational ports in India.

---

### 🚢 Infrastructure

Mundra Port operates **26 berths** across multiple specialized terminals with a total capacity of 228 MMTPA. The facility includes four container terminals handling 7.5 million TEUs annually, equipped with **deep-water berths up to 19 meters draft**.

The port is served by all major global shipping lines, including **Maersk, MSC, CMA CGM, Hapag-Lloyd, COSCO, and Evergreen**.

---

### 🏭 Special Economic Zone (SEZ)

The Port of Mundra is a private port and also a **Special Economic Zone (SEZ)**. The Mundra Special Economic Zone was incorporated in 2003 and became **India's first multi-product port-based special economic zone**.

---

### 🌍 Global Standing

Mundra Port is ranked **among the top 30 busiest container ports globally**.

In summary, Mundra is a **world-class, private, deep-draft, all-weather port** and one of the most strategically important trade gateways in Asia.
